title: Trigamy
summary: TRIG'AMY, noun [Gr. three, and marriage.] State of being married tree times; or the state of having three husbands or three wives at the same time.

inlines.v: TRIG'AMY, noun [Gr. three, and marriage.] State of being married tree times; or the state of having three husbands or three wives at the same time.
